author: newswithai_hq
text: Microsoft shipped out-of-band .NET fixes for a critical Brotli flaw, CVE-2026-111497. An unauthenticated attacker could read or corrupt memory. Fixed in .NET 8.0.33, 9.0.22, 10.0.14 and 11 RC3. Only apps using Brotli decompression are exposed. It is off by default.

author: UnicisTech
text: Node.js CVE-2026-111497 (Brotli decoder, can lead to RCE) affects Unicis Platform. Upgrade to v2026-10-27 (Node.js 22.23.4). Docker: rebuild and redeploy.

author: The_NewsCrypto
text: Japan's GMO Internet Group confirms a major cyberattack on its Onamae.com Desktop Cloud service, exposing customer data and leading to unauthorized trading activity. Up to 26,739 servers were potentially affected.

author: ptdbugs
text: PHP2Shell: what happened in the first 24 hours after disclosure. After PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) was publicly disclosed, Imperva recorded a surge of exploitation attempts.

author: TantoSecurity
text: From Arbitrary File Read to Shell: Yet Another RCE in Telerik. We exploit an arbitrary file read via RadImageEditor's image cache to leak web.config and, if it contains the right secrets, turn it into RCE. Update now to 2026.3.812.

author: sotappp9
text: NVIDIA scanned 31,132 agent skills and 5.2% looked malicious, roughly 1 in 19, and about a quarter had some vulnerability. Scan a skill before it goes anywhere near ~/.claude/skills; their scanner is SkillSpector (Apache 2.0).

author: krip_tom
text: Forever Security found a malicious AGENTS.md planted in ~/Downloads that told Codex to add an MCP server to its own config and install a malicious npm package.

author: alex_cuciureanu
text: GitLab patched CVE-2026-110264, a 10.0 integer overflow in regex compilation that could let an unauthenticated user run code on self-managed CE and EE servers. Versions go back to 7.0 from 2014. Fixed in 19.5.1, 19.4.3 and 19.3.6, per The Register.

author: awacinocom
text: Self-hosted Nextcloud servers are being backdoored through CVE-2026-110447 (CVSS 9.2) in the Collabora built-in CODE server app. No login needed: attackers planted web shells and searched for password databases and crypto wallets. CISA lists it as actively exploited.

author: threatcluster
text: Critical OS command injection vulnerability discovered in Vertiv Avocent ACS8000. Cyberattack disrupts UNM Health services, diverts ambulances. Remote code execution exploit for PHP 8.4.26 disclosed.

author: vidocsecurity
text: Last week's PHP2Shell vulnerability was discovered through OpenAI's Patch the Planet initiative. But can you really find critical bugs just by asking an LLM? We tested six frontier models on vulnerable PHP code to see what they'd catch and at what cost.

author: cxtodaynews
text: Developing: Genesys investigates a security incident affecting certain internal business systems, detected on October 16; the investigation is still ongoing.

author: timwork_notes
text: terraform-mcp-server with MCP_SESSION_MODE=stateless reused the first caller's token for every user after them... CVE-2026-16498, CVSS 10. No session id in stateless mode, so a cache keyed on session id sees one tenant.

author: teddyaisi
text: Pillar Security found remote code execution in opencode on Windows/WSL via MCP OAuth. A crafted authorization_endpoint ran as PowerShell. A remote MCP server that was fine at setup can go bad later through a compromise or an expired domain.

author: itsMikeKipruto
text: Palo Alto Networks confirms a critical Brotli vulnerability affecting some PAN-OS firewall deployments. CVE-2026-111497 carries a CVSS score of 9.2. A crafted compressed stream could trigger memory corruption, expose sensitive data, crash services, or potentially execute code.

author: undercode_news
text: ENGIE confirms customer data breach in France after attackers exploited a partner marketing platform.

author: CveTodo
text: CVE-2026-76938: critical authentication bypass in Hitachi JP1/Automatic Job Management System 3 Manager; CVE-2026-76934 critical stack buffer overflow in JP1/AJMS3 Manager and Agent.

author: SecurityAr58409
text: CVE-2026-114550: libwebsockets MQTT PUBACK out-of-bounds write. ZDI published ZDI-26-792 detailing a critical vulnerability.

author: linklin63793
text: Don't open Codex or Claude Code from your Downloads folder. Forever Security found a planted AGENTS.md on a real customer's machine telling the agent to npm install malware. In their tests Codex obeyed it 90%+ of the time. A CLAUDE.md variant got Claude Code to leak a token.

author: RomanChainOps
text: Keystone hardware wallet: WebAuth factory key compromise and 18,835 devices scrapped after a supply-chain security breach; a data breach also exposed over 38,000 customer records.

author: pdnuclei_bot
text: CVE-2026-18051 - critical: W3 Total Cache < 2.10.5 - Unauthenticated arbitrary directory file write (WordPress plugin). Nuclei template released.

author: alex_cuciureanu
text: CISA added CVE-2026-106931 to the KEV catalog: OS command injection in EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition that can let an attacker run arbitrary commands as root or SYSTEM.

author: Lhmisme
text: Three MCP implementations patched the same auth hole, and all three advisories say upgrading alone doesn't close it: a client fetches the authorization server's metadata and never checks that the issuer in the document matches where it was fetched from.

author: cubillas888
text: Supply chain attack postmortem from LiteLLM: a master key committed to a public repo on May 27 was never revoked. An org owner's unscoped GitHub token, taken Oct 10, then led to malicious 1.107.0 on Oct 21. Lesson: force-pushing over a commit isn't revoking a key.

author: HugoValters
text: CVE-2026-93993: RCE in Mistral Vibe (AI coding agent) before 2.25.5, git hooks run before trust validation. CVSS 8.8. Patch under review - restrict repo access now.

author: UpwindMDR
text: CRITICAL / HIGH - Multiple vulnerabilities patched in Rust zip (zip-rs/zip2) library, including dual-header parser differentials (Zip Cloaking) leading to arbitrary file overwrite/RCE and path traversal.

author: UpwindMDR
text: Critical - Consul-k8s cross-namespace ACL binding bypass (CVE-2026-110720): ACL binding rules let a pod/service account influence bindings outside its namespace and obtain elevated Consul ACL privileges.

author: ThreatWire_
text: A BeyondTrust Remote Support zero-day was used from 29 Aug. CISA added CVE-2026-102764 to KEV on 16 Oct. Self-hosted <=26.2.3: confirm the BT26-05-RS patch; check off-box logs if exposed while unpatched.

author: OhioValleyEV
text: Python still trusted leaked security certificates, so someone on your network could fake a secure website. Rated Critical (CVE-2026-115557). Fix: update to Python's Oct 26 releases.

author: ArcelieFernand2
text: Microsoft has linked Storm-0940 activity against Microsoft 365 to compromised credentials associated with ConnectWise Cloud Backup.

author: cryptomediazone
text: Railway: after a cloud breach, a thief drained $371,000 from 200+ crypto wallets whose keys were stored on Railway. The thefts began before Railway warned anyone.

author: BleepinComputer
text: CISA has added the PHP2Shell vulnerabilities to its catalog of actively exploited security flaws and ordered federal agencies to patch their systems by Thursday.

author: vuln_tracker
text: PHP2Shell is now in CISA KEV. CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 were added on Oct 26, federal due date Oct 29. Public exploit code is out, and Amazon saw probing from Oct 17, before the fix was public. Also affects Palo Alto PAN-OS and Panorama.

author: EmunaEliran
text: Supermicro server BMCs: CVE-2026-18450 (CVSS 9.8) - the BMC doesn't correctly enforce integrity and encryption requirements for IPMI commands, so crafted packets may inject IPMI commands into an active session.

author: ronvo2000
text: Millions of hacking attempts hit PHP sites worldwide: two critical RCE flaws in PHP (php2shell, CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619), discovered using AI and present for years. Cloudflare recorded thousands of attempts.

author: cubillas888
text: MCP server risk: Pillar Security says opencode on Windows and WSL could run an attacker's code during remote MCP OAuth sign-in. Fixed in 1.18.33 (Sept 28), with no advisory or CVE.

author: cubillas888
text: Data breach at Bubble: it confirms an attacker accessed plugin metadata, including private API keys, and downloaded data from apps whose editor was already public. Bubble believes the attacker is contained and has no evidence of private app data access. Forensics continue.

author: BadgerSignalHQ
text: One Brotli decoder bug. Node.js, .NET and Python all exposed. CVE-2026-111497 (Node2Shell / HTTP2Shell) is an out-of-bounds write in Google's Brotli decoder. A crafted compressed stream can corrupt memory, leading to crashes, data leaks or unauthenticated RCE.

author: CryptoThreadsX
text: Passport (Foundation) data leak: over 23,000 phishing emails sent after attackers exploited compromised Cloudflare API keys and old customer data that was never fully deleted.

author: BursaMatus
text: GMO Internet's FX cloud desktops (Onamae Desktop Cloud) were hacked: 26,739 servers at risk, saved trading logins stolen, rogue trades at OANDA and others. GMO won't pay the $50M demand; NHK says attackers leaked one client's data.
